newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Liberty eyes property jv with Singapore firm.
newsitem.headline: Liberty eyes property jv with Singapore firm.

text.p: Philippines' Liberty Mines Inc, soon to be known as Philcomsat Holdings Corp, is planning a joint venture with a Singapore-based industrial park developer, a top company official said on Thursday.

Philcomsat Holdings president Honorio Poblador III told reporters that the company is engaged in talks with the Singaporean firm for the development of a $24-million residential and industrial zone project in southern Manila.
Poblador refused to disclose the name of the Singaporean firm until plans for the creation of the joint venture company have been finalised.
He added that Philcomsat will also enter soon into a joint venture with a local low-to-medium cost housing developer for the development of a 56-hectare land in Cavite, southwest of Manila.
The board of Liberty approved early this month the change of its name to Philcomsat Holdings after the Philippine Communications Satellite Corp bought about 16 percent of the company in July.
The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has yet to approve Liberty's change in name and main business from a mining company to a holding company.
